title: Human Resource Management in public sector organisations

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts, methods, and techniques of human resource management in public sector organizations.
Analyze and evaluate the practical aspects of human resource management in public sector organizations.
Use research methods to analyze and evaluate the current state of human resource management in public sector organizations.
Work effectively in groups, demonstrating communication and presentation skills.
Evaluate the impact of economic, political, cultural, and social factors on human resource management in public sector organizations.
Demonstrate initiative in learning, research, and group work.
Apply knowledge and tools to analyze and evaluate the current state of human resource management in public sector organizations.
Understand and analyze the impact of public policies on human resource management in public sector organizations.
Develop strategic plans for human resource management in public sector organizations.
Understand and apply knowledge of public sector legislation related to human resource management.
